APPENDIX IV
FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT ON OPERATION BREAKTHROUGH
Chronology
Spring, 1969
Planning sessions begin on program to encourage housing production.
May 7, 8 & 9, 1969
Secretary George Romney announces Operation BREAKTHROUGH to meetings with governors, mayors, and leaders of industry and labor.
June 23, 1969
Request for Proposals No. H-55-69 is issued, calling for proposals for innovative housing systems.
July 2, 1969
Meeting held with governors, mayors to advise them on site selection requirements.
July 10, 1969
General briefing on RFP H-55-69 held in Washington.
August, 1969
Detailed site requirements set forth in Federal Register.
August 28, 1969
Request for Proposals No. H-9-70 issued calling for proposals for site planning teams.
September 19, 1969
601 proposals received in response to RFP H-55-69, 218 proposals received in response to request for prototype sites.
September 26, 1969
82 proposals received in response to RFP H-9-70.
September-December, 1969
Evaluation and ranking of housing systems proposals, site proposals and site planning proposals continues.
December 16, 1969
Thirty-seven "finalists" announced in housing systems competition. Eleven site planners selected. Nine of sleven sites selected.
February 23, 1970
Twenty-two housing systems selected. Final sites selected.
February-June, 1970
Contracts negotiated with housing systems, site planners.
April 18, 1970
Requirements and invitation for prototype site developers published in Federal Register.
May 4, 1970
Indications of interest received from 68 proposers.
